correctness.rationale: The source supplies the closed embedding and K.C=n-3 (arXiv:2610.12071v1, Lemma 2.1, Lemma 3.1, Proposition 3.3, Proposition 4.1). The direct matrix action on normal vectors is the scalar factor 1/(c*tau+d), replicated n-1 times. At infinity the width-three cusp translation fixes all normal coordinates, and the source transports that chart to each other cusp by block-diagonal SL2(Z) matrices, preserving the independent identical line summands. Adjunction gives deg N=1-n, so their common degree is -1, whence N=O(-1)^(n-1). H0=H1=0; the tangent space to Hilb is zero, making its local point reduced and isolated. All parameters and cusp cases are covered, not inferred from samples.

value.rationale: The construction newly supplies rational curves meeting the interior of compactified complex hyperbolic manifolds. Their normal splitting is a natural exact invariant controlling embedded deformations; determining it uniformly rules out any infinitesimal deformation and proves the Hilbert point reduced and isolated. This is not determined by total canonical degree, as different splitting types with the same degree have different h0. The result unifies the (-1)-curve surface case and (-1,-1)-curve threefold case while avoiding unsupported contraction claims.
